verdict: PASS with open items. All three round-3 fixes verified against their acceptance checks (R3-01, R3-02, R3-03 resolved); all 11 round-1 and 5 round-2 findings were already verified resolved in rounds 2–3 and I re-checked their key numbers. No headline number changed over the loop; what changed is that every unconditional or false claim found (k1 'every lap', camera-independent 'no bias', image 'support' for the correction direction, 7/29 camera aim, contact timing 'tens of ms') is now stated with its condition or its per-event spread, and the stored data, the report and the local page agree with each other. What remains is limited by data (lens calibration, wet-day footage, gyro scale) or waits on the owner (onset definition, human confirmation, WORKLOG wording, republish).
